responsibility: This definition module declares the Logitech-compatible pseudo-random number API for GNU Modula-2. It exports initialization routines for seeding the generator and procedures that produce random bytes, bounded integers and cardinals, and normalized REAL or LONGREAL values, providing a small compatibility layer over host randomness.
same_name_distinction: Definition half of the Random pair: it declares the Logitech-compatible random API and exported procedures, while Random.mod supplies the rand/srand-based behavior and startup seeding.
